obligation.exact_statement: For the same Route A finite frontend, complete visible representation, history/query and TV risk, analyze the legal comparator replacing matched values x_j by S x_j and uniform values (x_j,c_j) by S(x_j,c_j), for a declared positive integer S independent of theta, followed by a charged fixed linear factor 1/S before the existing correction/simplex readout. Prove ideal equality to unscaled A and determine how a coordinatewise absolute perturbation delta at the same post-attention location propagates after rescaling; distinguish this from a matched relative-error or rescaled-absolute-error model. Fully account for extra value/activation range, parameter magnitude/storage, incoming rational encoding cap, linear computation and all duplicate/residual streams, with explicit conditions under which both designs fit one common resource cap (in particular investigate S=N-2 under the existing conservative cap). Show exactly which normalized-summary lower-bound claims remain valid or are evaded. Do not infer new information, optimality, a generic precision lower bound, or architecture superiority from a change of units. This is a mathematical same-budget/located-error comparison prerequisite for the parent finite-N theorem, not a change of the frozen root.

assumptions: D1-D8 are the frozen first-stage definitions; theta is unknown at prediction time.
Stationary initialization and strictly positive symbol-successor probabilities hold per fixed theta, without a common lower bound across the rare family.
All network-visible side information and resources are charged. Primary guarantees are forward guarantees, not unproved learnability claims.
Full-context and itemwise kernels, rare and uniform process families, and distinct error models remain separately scoped.

Rare parameters and interaction parameters exactly as D4-D5. Additional uniform-rate bounds are explicit conditional subfamilies, not changes to the mother problem.
